messages:
Sam: Need a quick copy + a11y pass for the new 'Apply policy' confirmation toast. Current toast says 'Policy applied' and disappears. Customers told us it's confusing about scope and rollback.
Ivy: Yeah we should surface scope (org vs project) and offer an undo. Toasts are ephemeral so add explicit CTA 'View changes' and an undo action inline.
Noah: Engineering note: we can keep undo for 30s and link to the activity log. Proposed short toast: 'Policy applied to project: Payments. Undo | View changes' — but needs to work for org-wide.
Jules: Tone: keep it calm and informative. For org-wide: 'Policy applied to organization. Changes may affect all projects.' For project: 'Policy applied to project • {project name}'. Include an icon for scope.
Sam: Accessibility: toast must be role="status" for success, aria-live="polite". Undo should be a real button with keyboard focus. When user clicks 'View changes' we open a slide-over; move focus into it.
Ivy: Copy variants: success short = 'Policy applied. Undo' expanded = 'Policy "Restrict external models" applied to organization. Affects 12 projects. View changes for details.' Keep counts optional.
Noah: If apply fails partially (some projects unreachable), we need a failure toast that summarizes and points to details. Example failure: 'Policy applied to 8/12 projects. View details' with small note in details panel about retry. Role should be alert.
Jules: Also microcopy for undo action state: while undoing show 'Reverting…' and on success show 'Reverted' toast. SR should announce these state transitions.
Sam: Button labels: Primary inline = 'Undo' (makes sense), secondary link = 'View changes'. For mobile compact toast use 'Undo' and an icon-only 'details' button with proper aria-label.
Ivy: For the slide-over header: 'Policy change details' and body: bullet list of projects affected, timestamp, actor, and per-project status. For empty changes case: 'No changes recorded' (rare). Make sure 'View changes' link text is always descriptive.
Noah: Failure class examples for toast copy: - Partial: 'Policy applied to 8/12 projects — 4 failed. View details.' - Full fail: 'Policy application failed. View details or retry.' Include quick action 'Retry' in details panel.
Jules: Final checklist for UX spec: 1) Short toast variants for org/project/success/partial/fail. 2) Undo semantics + 30s window. 3) ARIA roles: success->role=status/aria-live=polite, failure->role=alert/aria-live=assertive. 4) Focus management for slide-over. 5) Mobile compact labels with aria-labels.
Sam: I'll update the spec and add copy table with exact strings for each state. Will follow up with Eng on undo window. Thanks all :sparkles:
